findings.observation: Two sibling port classes carry the same members. Slice05: 'private int GravityWithItsReadyRule(params (string WorkItem, string Tag)[] tags)', 'private const int GravitysCycleWorkingDays = 7;', 'private const string ReadyTag = "ready";', 'private const string Below = "Below";', 'private void GivenTheTeamIsLikelyToPullFiveToEightOverItsCycle()', 'private RefinementViewDto WhenTheCoachOpensTheRefinementTab(int team)'. NeedOverOneCycleSpecifications.cs repeats each, and keeps its own 'private static NeedReading NeedIn(RefinementViewDto tab)' and 'private sealed record NeedReading(' beside the new base 'protected static NeedFacts TheNeedOn(RefinementViewDto tab)' and 'protected sealed record NeedFacts(' (same 7 fields, same mapping). Divergence risk when the need DTO gains a field. Medium.
findings.remediation: Crafter: hoist the Gravity ready-rule builder, the tab-as-DTO reader, ReadyTag, GravitysCycleWorkingDays and the five-to-eight script into RefinementAtThePortTest or RefinementPortGivens; make NeedOverOneCycleSpecifications use NeedFacts/TheNeedOn and delete its copies. NeedOverOneCycle files are not S2 oracle bytes, so this is allowed.

findings.observation: 'public int ATeamWhoseBacklogHolds(string name, int workItems)' takes a Team name but builds '$"Nebula Work Item {number}"' and 'NB-{number:D3}' whatever name is passed. Name and content disagree for any caller but Team Nebula. Low. Its shape beside GravityRefines is coincidental similarity, not a DRY violation.
findings.remediation: Crafter: derive prefix and title from the Team name, or rename the builder to the Nebula-specific fact and drop the generic name parameter.
